hook.line: This one thing you need to be doing on every single post: SEO.
hook.visual: Close selfie face with hands reaching toward the lens; pinned white top title ('...get out of 200 view jail') over a red 'Quick tutorial' pill; sentence captions low.

beats.what: Names the one thing (SEO on every post) while the pinned title promises escape from '200 view jail'.
Quick credibility intro: 15 years in digital marketing, helping creators over 50 monetize.
Step one: open Creator Search Insights, type your subject and screenshot what people actually search.
Lists every place to use the keywords: first three seconds, text on screen, captions.
Teases the trick: type keywords on screen, shrink them and slide them off-frame.
Step two: keywords in the hook and on-screen text, ideally inside the first three seconds.
Explains why: the more often keywords appear, the better TikTok knows who to push to.
Step three in the editor: add as many keyword phrases as you like, squish them down, slide them off.
The detail most miss: drag the text bar's right arrow across the whole clip so keywords last the full video.
Wrap-up: keywords in captions too, or stay stuck in 200-view jail; asks for follows and questions.

why_it_works: Pinned title names a pain every small creator feels ('200 view jail') and stays up for all 160 s, so a viewer arriving at any moment knows the promise.
Speaks from the first frame (first word at 0.0 s) with a 'one thing' promise, so the viewer waits for the single answer.
Hands move toward the lens constantly and the face fills the frame (face height median 0.382), which keeps a no-cut, single-take video feeling alive.
The concrete editor detail (drag the text bar's arrow across the whole clip) is insider know-how that rewards saving the video.
weaknesses: Zero cuts in 160 s and no visuals of Creator Search Insights or the editor; the steps are only described, never shown.
Credentials intro sits right after the hook and delays the first step to 28 s.
Quiet mix (-21.6 LUFS) and 77% of text outside the safe area.
for_robert: Use a pinned top title that names the viewer's pain in their own slang (like '200 view jail') for the whole reel; avoid her 160 s single take with no on-screen demo, and let Fred show the steps she only describes.
